lcc_original: 第三道河名叫希底結【8】，就是流在亞述東邊的。第四道河就是伯拉河【9】。
notes: 就是 in both clauses explicitly renders what was implicit {<WAH01931>} in UNV (Hebrew הוּא), so braces dropped and tag attached as normal
LCC 希底結 = UNV 底格里斯 (both = Hiddekel/Tigris, different transcription conventions); similarly LCC 伯拉河 = UNV 幼發拉底河 (Euphrates)
Footnote markers 【8】 and 【9】 kept in place; SN inserted before them after the river name
LCC preposition 在 has no Hebrew counterpart (implied by construct chain קִדְמַת אַשּׁוּר); left unannotated
LCC structural particle 的 at end of first clause has no Hebrew counterpart; left unannotated
